title: Humanity's Last Exam

model.params_source: paper Appendix C.5 Table 4 (o3-mini supports only temperature 1.0); Table 1 row O3-MINI (HIGH) -> reasoning_effort=high; max tokens not stated (use max_completion_tokens 16384); top_p not configurable; machine form: reasoning_effort high added (Table 1 row O3-MINI (HIGH)); the runner drops temperature/top_p for o3-mini and sends max_completion_tokens 16384

task.subset_rule: paper-defined: text-only questions (empty image field) of the 2,500-question release; ~14% are multi-modal (Sec. 3.1), so about 2,150 items - pin the HF revision of Feb 2025
task.approximation: Exact text-only count and the release revision must be confirmed from the parquet; the judge is o3-mini-2025-01-31 with structured decoding as in the paper.

items.config_or_split: default / test (2,500 rows on the card; parquet data/test-00000-of-00001.parquet 274 MB)

fields_prose.label: answer
fields_prose.answer_type: answer_type (exactMatch | multipleChoice) selects the system prompt

items.access_note: Hub parquet listing exists (default/test, one file, 274 MB) but answers 401 without an accepted-terms token; not downloaded (gated and > 100 MB)

prompt.source_location: Appendix C.1.1 'Evaluation' (system prompts for exact-match and multiple-choice questions; judge prompt)
prompt.verbatim: full (the braces inside the system prompt are literal text as printed, not slots)

placeholders_prose.question: items.input as the user message; for answer_type == multipleChoice use the multiple-choice system prompt given in notes

output.parse_prose: judge output fields: correct (yes/no), extracted_final_answer, confidence

metric.name: accuracy
metric.definition: share of text-only questions judged 'yes' (correct) by the o3-mini judge; RMS calibration error (80) from the confidence field is secondary
metric.judge: llm:o3-mini-2025-01-31 with structured decoding, prompt Appendix C.1.1 (verbatim in notes)
metric.original_location: Table 1, row O3-MINI (HIGH) (text-only subset); identical in Appendix C.2 Table 2

open_points: data: cais/hle is gated (401 without an accepted-terms token) and the parquet is 274 MB with embedded images; a human must accept the terms, download the Feb-2025 revision of data/test-00000-of-00001.parquet (or export a text-only jsonl with id, question, answer, answer_type, image) and place it under external/data/tierb_items/W4410280647/ - the hook then loads it and keeps the text-only rows.

everything else is in the hook: system prompt selected by answer_type, 'Exact Answer:' parse, o3-mini-2025-01-31 judge stage with the Appendix C.1.1 prompt and structured decoding (run with --judge), accuracy = share judged 'yes'. The judge model is live (dying 2026-10-23), not dead.
runner_gaps: prompt: system prompt selected by an item field
hook: harness/tierb/hooks/W4410280647.py: load_items (local gated copy, text-only filter), render (system_by_answer_type), parse, judge_requests (o3-mini-2025-01-31, json_schema), score_with_judge (accuracy; per-item 0/1)
